hooks.command: DATA_DIR=.excavator; [ -f $DATA_DIR/config.json ] && grep -q '"autoUpdate".*true' $DATA_DIR/config.json && [ -f $DATA_DIR/meta.json ] && [ -f $DATA_DIR/knowledge-graph.json ] && [ "$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$DATA_DIR/meta.json','utf8')).gitCommitHash")" != "$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" ] && echo "[excavator] Knowledge graph may be stale (HEAD has moved since the last analysis). Read the file at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/auto-update-prompt.md, follow its instructions to detect what structurally changed, and propose running /excavator to the user with a summary of the detected changes. Wait for the user's decision before updating the graph." || true
